secs.t: State schemes launched - name, department, objective, beneficiaries, launch date

x: Exam angle: "primary goal of P4" = poverty eradication; match scheme → department/benefit.

complete eradication of poverty

secs.t: Welfare pensions - categories, monthly amount, total monthly outlay

x: The ₹4,000 group includes old-age persons, widows, weavers, toddy tappers, fishermen, single women, transgender persons, artists and others.

at the doorstep on the first day of every month
, observed as 'Pedala Sevalo' day.
New provisions in 2026 included
spouse pensions for surviving wives
and pensions for dialysis and organ-transplant patients.

secs.t: Scheme limits - coverage ceiling, eligibility, model of delivery

x: The hybrid model provides insurance of ₹2.5 lakh per person for all residents and trust-funded treatment up to
₹25 lakh per family
for poor families.
APSES 2024–25 provides the stated procedure ceiling, total ceiling, unlimited cancer coverage and income eligibility up to ₹5 lakh.
APSES 2024–25 runs alongside
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
, which provides coverage of ₹5 lakh per family.

secs.t: Programme acronyms → full form + sector

x: SHRESTH is run by
CDSCO
under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and benchmarks State drug regulators.

Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement
and functions as an AP Police anti-drug force.

e-governance

x: EAGLE was assigned to
check ganja and drugs at the village level
EAGLE signed an MoU with the
Indian Red Cross Society
on 28 August 2026 for village-level action against ganja and drugs.
EAGLE expands to Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement, its “EAGLE on Train” drive targets ganja, and it is headed by IGP A. Ravi Krishna.

x: The Monthly Economic Reports use 651 KPIs, Andhra Pradesh was the first State to institutionalise them and to have a dedicated quantum computing policy, and APEX Korea was established at Busan.
Alluri Sitharama Raju district became first in India under the Basic Infrastructure theme in the March 2026 Aspirational Districts ranking.
Alluri Sitharama Raju district achieved 100 per cent digitisation of
SIR forms

secs.t: State government apps and portals → purpose + department

x: Mana Mitra is the WhatsApp Governance platform for citizen services, including temple tickets and hall tickets.
Mana Mitra operates through the WhatsApp number 95523 00009.
Mana Mitra enabled
complaints through voice notes
in June 2026.
OWMS monitors more than 800 water and sewerage works in 123 urban local bodies.
The AI City Flood Alert system was first started in
Vijayawada

secs.t: Partnerships with national/international institutions → sector

x: UN-Habitat
signed the July 2026 MoU concerning the urban sector and a Centre of Excellence at Amaravati.
The Gates Foundation partnership covers AI, health and agriculture; the World Bank supports SALT and, with ADB, Amaravati works; and UN-Habitat is linked to the Centre of Excellence at Amaravati.
ICRISAT was set up at Hyderabad in 1972 with help from
the United Nations

secs.t: Administrative changes and appointments

x: Polavaram and Markapuram
were created from 31 December 2025, increasing the total from 26 to 28 districts.
G. Sai Prasad
, a 1991-batch officer, succeeded K. Vijayanand as Chief Secretary.

Sri City International University is at Tirupati and was established through an ordinance in June 2026; Chalapathi University is at Guntur, while a private women’s university was established in July 2026.

secs.t: State legislation - Bills passed by the AP Assembly

x: The Omnibus Bill amended the
Fire Service Act 1999, Single Window Clearance Act 2002 and Public Service Delivery Guarantee Act 2017
The
AP Municipal Laws (Third Amendment) Bill, 2026
provided for a uniform mutation fee on title transfers.
The four higher-education Bills converted the Regulatory Commission into a fee-regulation committee and reduced the land requirement for private universities.

x: AWARE is a
predictive-governance tool
and was shown at the NITI Aayog Governing Council in June 2026.
Mana Mitra provides WhatsApp-based services such as
temple services and darshan tickets
ASR district achieved 100% electoral-roll digitalisation and ranked first in India in Basic Infrastructure under the NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts Programme rankings of March 2026.

is the Chief Minister heading the TDP-led NDA Government in Andhra Pradesh.
K. Pawan Kalyan holds Panchayat Raj and Rural Development, along with Environment and Forests.
Nara Lokesh holds the portfolios of Human Resource Development and Information Technology.
The conference included
district roadmaps under Swarna Andhra and Super Six
among its 19 subjects.

x: Polavaram district was carved from the
ASR district
, comprising the Rampachodavaram and Chinturu divisions.
Markapuram district was carved from Western Prakasam, covering the Markapuram and Kanigiri divisions.
Markapuram is the headquarters; the district has 21 mandals and approximately 11.42 lakh people.
The Madanapalle, Pileru and Rayachoti divisions together comprise 25 mandals.

secs.t: Capital decisions - capital city, related Acts

x: Section 5
of the 2014 Act provided for Hyderabad to function as the common capital for ten years, up to June 2024.
The governance framework was to be designed in line with
the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments
concerning local self-government.
Justice Lisa Gill is expected to become the first woman Chief Justice of the
Andhra Pradesh High Court

x: The system was renamed the Swarna Gramam & Ward Secretariat system.
The system mapped 1.68 crore households and completed e-KYC for 1.71 crore families.
The AP Public Employment Order, 2025 provided for
six zones and two multi-zones

Articles 243K and 243ZA
, dealing with elections to Panchayats and Municipalities respectively.

together provide the three-tier monitoring structure for Vision 2047.

x: APCNF is implemented by
Rythu Sadhikara Samstha
, commonly abbreviated as RySS.
APCNF uses cow-based inputs including Jeevamrutham, develops NTR district as a natural-farming model and uses QR traceability for produce.
Annadata Sukhibhava provides
annually per farmer, comprising the State share of ₹14,000 and the Centre's ₹6,000 under PM-KISAN.

Pasu Bhima Padhakam is a livestock insurance scheme in which the Centre pays 40%, the State 40% and the farmer 20%; it covers BPL, SC and ST farmers.

secs.t: Health schemes - coverage and model

x: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva covers
1.43 crore families and 3,257 procedures
through cashless care.
Amrutha is intended for orphans, not marine fishermen.
Sanjeevani envisages screening
66 lakh high-risk people and 5 lakh hostel students

secs.t: Flagship poverty eradication - P4

x: P4 stands for
Public-Private-People Partnership
and was launched on 30 March 2025.
P4 aims at
complete eradication of poverty
, expressed through the Zero Poverty sutram.
P4 is described as a voluntary, society-wide model in which the government facilitates rather than operating it as a compulsory tax-funded transfer programme.
The first phase of P4 covered approximately
21.8 lakh
families.

secs.t: Housing and welfare - houses, LPG, free bus

x: The current target is
5.52 lakh houses by March 2027 and a house for every eligible family by 2029
; 7.60 lakh by 2026 was the earlier target.
Free APSRTC bus travel for women under Stree Shakti began on
15 August 2025
Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders annually, covers 1.84 crore beneficiaries and involved ₹1,554.06 crore during April-December 2025.

secs.t: Schemes renamed after the 2024 change of government

x: Amma Vodi was renamed Talliki Vandanam.
In 2014, Rajiv Aarogyasri was renamed NTR Vaidya Seva and Indiramma housing was renamed NTR Housing.
